history.event: Claude refinement: 28 line(s) suggested — Corrected garbled names and formula words (francº banchini, di ß, rogata/rogate, cessione, ꝓmessa, mezo, darezo, loro, dote), removed edge spaces on l1 and l12, and left the entry initials (Jtē) and the most uncertain words as Kraken read them for Laura to decide. | layout: l9: tiny box in the left margin beside l11 holding only a stray stroke; '5' is probably a hallucination, so delete the box or blank the line; l19: empty sliver box on the descender of the initial J of l21; delete it; l26: the box covers only 'rogata'; 'ꝓ ß' to its right falls outside the outline (included in the suggestion); l13: the 'ß' that closes this entry ('rogato ꝓ ß') is written alone on the next line, above l14, and has no box; l10, l12, l14, l17, l20, l22, l24, l27: Kraken misreads every entry-opening initial (probably Jtē) as Rꝓ / Ro / 𝓎 ⫳ ꝓ / 7 / ⫳ ꝓ / ꝓ ß / L ꝓ / I ꝓ | doubts: l7, l8, l12, l15, l17, l18, l28: the abbreviated women's titles and names (mª/mona? before lita, piera, magdalena, antonia) are read as 9, iº, 9ª, oi, oc; I could not settle the glyph, so most are left as Kraken read them; l13/l24/l25: the surname is written bachinj in some places and banchinj in others; check whether the n is there; l1: 'Ricordo' from the image (Kraken 'Racordo'); the rest of the line ('ātratti 2 qªi Ioo amē de') is unclear; l20: delaparra / octamano (octaviano?) not resolved; l22: laromiōtia (larinumptia?) not resolved; l27: lostrumēto? / pacti facti? read only partly; l30: 'scripture' for Kraken 'sciptureo' is uncertain; l32 and l33: too unclear to correct reliably; the sum in l33 (ƒ 2 …) needs a check against the image
